Lemon Drizzle Cake
Serves 8
A zesty classic.

Ingredients
200g self-raising flour
3 large eggs
1 1/2 tsp baking powder
2 x 400g tins chopped tomatoes
½ cup (120ml) milk, warmed
Salt

For the drizzle
100g icing sugar
juice of 2 lemons

Method
1. Heat the oven to 180C.
2. Beat the eggs and sugar.
then fold in the flour.
3. Bake for 40 minutes.

Notes
Keeps 3 days.

Pasta
Ingredients:
- 250 g spaghetti
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 3-4 tbsp olive oil
Instructions
Boil the pasta in salted water for 10 minutes. Drain well.
Fry the garlic in the oil.
Toss together and serve.

Soup
Total time: 1 hr 15 min
serves 4
500 g carrots
1 onion (diced)
Peel and chop everything.
Simmer for 30 minutes.
